messages.content: "請問您能告訴我紐約洋基隊在2019年球季MLB的排名，然後查看洛杉磯湖人隊在2020年球季NBA的排名，最後，您能提供2020年12月25日洛杉磯和2021年1月1日紐約的空氣質量指數嗎？"

2. Los Angeles Lakers ranking in 2020 NBA season.
3. Air quality index for Los Angeles on December 25, 2020.
4. Air quality index for New York on January 1, 2021.

Then call air_quality twice (Los Angeles 2020-12-25, New York 2021-01-01). The user wants all four results. We should call the tools sequentially. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we should call the first tool: sports_ranking for Yankees 2019. Then second: sports_ranking for Lakers 2020. Then third: air_quality for Los Angeles 2020-12-25.
